title: Sum of Two Numbers
description: Given two integers, return their sum.
input_format: Two integers, each on a new line.
output_format: The sum of the two integers.

title: Reverse a String
description: Given a string, return the reversed string.
input_format: A single string.
output_format: The reversed string.

title: Factorial
description: Calculate the factorial of a non-negative integer.
input_format: A single non-negative integer.
output_format: The factorial of the integer.

title: Palindrome Check
description: Check if a given string is a palindrome (reads the same backward as forward).
input_format: A single string.
output_format: True if the string is a palindrome, False otherwise.
constraints: 1 <= length of string <= 100.  String contains only lowercase letters.

title: Find the Maximum
description: Find the maximum value in a list of integers.
input_format: The first line contains the number of integers, n. The second line contains n space-separated integers.
output_format: The maximum integer in the list.

title: Fibonacci Sequence
description: Generate the nth Fibonacci number.
input_format: A single non-negative integer, n.
output_format: The nth Fibonacci number (starting from 0: 0, 1, 1, 2, ...).

title: Prime Number Check
description: Check if a given integer is a prime number.
input_format: A single positive integer.
output_format: True if the integer is prime, False otherwise.

title: Count Vowels
description: Count the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in a given string.
input_format: A single string.
output_format: The number of vowels in the string.
constraints: 1 <= length of string <= 100. String contains only lowercase letters.

title: Average of Numbers
description: Calculate the average of a list of numbers.
input_format: The first line contains the number of numbers, n. The second line contains n space-separated numbers.
output_format: The average of the numbers, rounded to two decimal places.

title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.
input_format:
The first line contains the number of elements in array `nums`, `n`. 
The second line contains the `n` space-separated integers of the array `nums`. 
The third line contains the integer `target`.
output_format: A list of two space-separated indices of the numbers that add up to the `target`, sorted in ascending order. If there's no such pair, return -1 -1.
constraints: 2 <= n <= 1000. -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000. -1000 <= target <= 1000. There is exactly one solution.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of integers and a target value, find the index of the target value in the array. If the target value is not found, return -1.
input_format:
The first line contains the number of elements in array `nums`, `n`. 
The second line contains the `n` space-separated integers of the sorted array `nums`. 
The third line contains the integer `target`.
output_format: The index of the target value in the array. If the target value is not found, return -1.

title: Calculate the Area of a Rectangle
description: Calculate the area of a rectangle given its length and width.
input_format: Two integers, representing the length and width of the rectangle, each on a new line.
output_format: The area of the rectangle.

title: String to Integer
description: Convert a string to an integer.
input_format: A single string representing an integer.
output_format: The integer value of the string.

title: Integer to String
description: Convert a integer to string.
input_format: A single integer.
output_format: The String value of the integer.

title: Find the Minimum
description: Find the minimum value in a list of integers.
input_format: The first line contains the number of integers, n. The second line contains n space-separated integers.
output_format: The minimum integer in the list.

title: Reverse Words in a String
description: Given a string, reverse the order of words in the string.
input_format: A single string containing multiple words separated by spaces.
output_format: The string with the words reversed.

title: Check Anagrams
description: Determine if two strings are anagrams of each other (contain the same characters in a different order).
input_format: Two strings, each on a new line.
output_format: True if the strings are anagrams, False otherwise.
constraints: 1 <= length of strings <= 100. Strings contain only lowercase letters.

title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
description: Given a sorted array of integers, remove the duplicates in-place such that each element appears only once.
input_format: The first line contains the number of integers, n. The second line contains n space-separated integers.
output_format: The length of the array after removing duplicates.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100. -1000 <= each integer <= 1000. The array is sorted.

title: Sum of Digits
description: Calculate the sum of the digits of a non-negative integer.
input_format: A single non-negative integer.
output_format: The sum of the digits of the integer.

title: Implement strStr()
description: Implement strStr(). Given two strings needle and haystack, return the index of the first occurrence of needle in haystack, or -1 if needle is not part of haystack.
input_format: Two strings, needle and haystack, each on a new line.
output_format: The index of the first occurrence of needle in haystack, or -1.
